title: SpecForge Configuration
description: Configuration file for a SpecForge project. Like tsconfig.json for TypeScript, this file defines project identity, extensions and providers.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocomplete and validation.

name.description: Project name. Used in output headers and reports.

version.description: Format version of .spec files. The compiler checks compatibility.

spec_root.description: Path to .spec files relative to the project root directory.

exclude.description: Patterns, relative to the spec root, of .spec files that are not project sources: not compiled (check, watch, the LSP and MCP), formatted or migrated, and named by no import. `*` and `?` match within one name, `**` any number of directories, `[...]` one character of a set. An entry with no slash except a trailing one matches a name at any depth ("drafts" leaves out drafts/a.spec and sub/drafts/b.spec); an entry with a slash at its start or in its middle is anchored at the spec root ("/drafts", "sub/drafts"); a trailing slash matches directories only. A file is left out when an entry matches its path or one of its directories.

items.description: A pattern such as "drafts", "**/*.draft.spec" or "sub/old/". An entry starting with ! (exclude has no negation), with a . or .. name, or with an empty name can match no source: specforge.json reports it (E069) and it is ignored.

strict.description: When true, warnings are treated as errors.

display_prefix.description: Optional display prefix for reports (e.g., "HP"). Does not affect entity IDs.

extensions.description: The extensions that extend the entity model: a builtin or installed extension by name (`@scope/name`), or a component file (`path.wasm`, or `name=path.wasm` with the name it declares; relative to the project root).

enhancement_policy.description: How to resolve conflicts when two extensions enhance the same field on the same entity kind.

enhancement_overrides.description: Explicit conflict resolution for enhancement conflicts. Keys are 'entity.field' (e.g., 'behavior.layer'), values are the winning extension package name.

entity_kind_policy.description: How to resolve conflicts when two extensions register the same entity kind name.

entity_kinds.description: Explicit conflict resolution for entity kind conflicts. Keys are kind names, values are the winning extension package name.

providers.description: Provider configurations for external reference validation (GitHub, Jira, Figma, etc.), in declaration order: when two providers declare one scheme, the first wins (E057). Two instances of one provider use two schemes.

personas.description: Persona definitions for capability validation. Keys are persona IDs.

surfaces.description: Surface definitions for capability validation. Keys are surface IDs.

inference.description: Project-level inference hints that override or append to extension defaults.

registries.description: Extension registries used by add/update/search/publish/login. SpecForge has no built-in registry: without this key those commands fail with E063.

provider.description: One provider instance: the ref scheme it serves, its alias, the extension that implements it, and that extension's settings.

scheme.description: The ref scheme this instance serves (e.g., "gh" for gh:42). Unique across providers.

alias.description: The instance's name (e.g., "main"). Unique across providers.

extension.description: The extension that implements the provider (e.g., "@acme/github"); it must be enabled in extensions.

settings.description: Provider-specific settings, passed to the extension as they are (e.g., {"repo": "org/repo"}).

surface_type.description: Optional type classification for this surface.

scope_filter.description: Only operate on scopes matching this filter

default_registry.description: Serve every package no scope_filter matches

$comment: Keys consumed via raw passthrough by the compiler (not typed on ProjectConfig): providers, personas, surfaces, enhancement_policy, enhancement_overrides, entity_kind_policy, entity_kinds, strict, namespace, display_prefix. Registry client reads 'registries'; inference is typed on ProjectConfig.
